findings.evidenceJa: 人に偽らず、人に騙されない
findings.governingReading: Saber praises both Taiga's refusal to deceive others and her resistance to being deceived.
findings.explanation: Saber's praise keeps Taiga's honesty but drops her resistance to deception. It does not explicitly call her gullible, but it removes one half of the compliment.
